entities.name: NA hierarchical assembly
observations: Nascent adhesions show a conditional two-step organization: phospho-Cas/Crk clusters with inactive bent β1-integrin precede activation and recruitment of talin, kindlin, vinculin, and paxillin; talin and vinculin can also be recruited concurrently.
Nanoscale layering and temporal precedence support hierarchy, but not one universal linear sequence.

entities.name: NA variable stoichiometry
observations: Integrin:talin ratios change as adhesions mature under altered contractility in Drosophila muscle attachment sites.
Adhesion protein islands vary broadly in size, composition, copy number, and stoichiometry; individual adhesions also show weakly correlated compositional responses.

entities.name: NA mechanochemical feedback
observations: β1-integrin engagement activates Src/FAK–RhoA–formin/myosin signaling, while talin-mediated vinculin activation couples actomyosin to the membrane and promotes nanoclustering, supporting parallel feedback rather than deterministic assembly.

entities.name: PMID:37489578
observations: Reported an early phospho-Cas/Crk cluster state containing inactive bent β1-integrin followed by integrin activation and recruitment of talin, kindlin, vinculin, and paxillin.

entities.name: PMID:33783351
observations: Reported concurrent early talin and vinculin recruitment and a load-free talin–vinculin interaction important for nascent-adhesion maturation.

entities.name: PMID:34035280
observations: Reported distinct kindlin membrane diffusion and PH-domain-dependent membrane-proximal localization, with roles in integrin immobilization and activation.

entities.name: PMID:28446705
observations: Quantitative imaging linked contractility to adhesion-component levels and changing integrin:talin ratios during maturation.

entities.name: PMID:37278764
observations: Ultrafast PALM/dSTORM identified adhesion protein islands with diverse size, composition, copy number, and stoichiometry.

entities.name: PMID:29391434
observations: Four-color imaging showed weakly correlated, adhesion-specific responses of FAK, vinculin, paxillin, and zyxin to contractility perturbation.

entities.name: PMID:31104842
observations: Linked β1-integrin ligand engagement to Src/FAK–RhoA–formin/myosin signaling and talin-vinculin-mediated actomyosin coupling and nanoclustering.
